role: Post-review delivery metadata; no scientific candidate mutation.

exclusion_policy.scope: All eleven raw external retrieval responses under inputs/literature/.
exclusion_policy.local_frozen_candidate: Retain original response bytes and original review manifest unchanged.
exclusion_policy.reason_ko: 외부 논문 본문·긴 발췌와 검색 서비스의 원 응답을 배포물에 재수록하지 않는다. 연구 유도·계산 코드·검산 결과·선별 서지와 원문 위치는 별도 파일로 제공하고, retrieval cache는 identity와 query/URL 메타데이터만 전달한다.
exclusion_policy.index_contains: Original response relative path, byte count, SHA256, saved request metadata, source URLs/DOIs, and frozen-manifest linkage.
exclusion_policy.index_excludes: Returned paper full text, abstracts, highlights, excerpts and service response bodies.

frozen_manifest_relation.meaning: The frozen 72-file review inventory still includes these eleven locally retained responses. Distribution omits those response payloads intentionally; this index records the difference without deleting or rewriting the frozen manifest.
frozen_manifest_relation.not_a_replacement_for: The original responses or their full frozen-byte audit.

literature_navigation.context: Four primary comparisons are contextual; discovery hits are not automatically accepted sources or proof dependencies.

reacquisition.method: Use the recorded source URL or DOI under the provider/publisher access conditions, preserving new retrieval metadata separately.
reacquisition.identity_caveat: A later retrieval can differ in body, service wrapper or metadata. Its bytes must not be relabeled with the old response SHA256.
